name: Three-Section Forest Deletion in the Seven-Cube
definition: Remove the monotone eight-word coordinate path from $Q_7$, obtaining a rank-five maximum class. Delete its singleton minimum sections on blocks $\{3,4,5,6,7\}$, $\{1,4,5,6,7\}$, and $\{1,2,3,4,5\}$ with patterns $00000$, $10000$, and $11111$ respectively.
properties: The deleted words are $0100000$, $1010000$, and $1111101$. The first two patterns agree and each disagrees with the third, so the disagreement graph is a path. The residual class is ample with 117 words. The forest construction gives a rank-five maximum parent on ten coordinates with 638 words.
